note: Round 3. Calibration keeps C1-C6 and adds two closed-stand squares (K1, K2) in the southern wood, on holes already used for calibration. The round-1 (E2-E4) and round-2 (H1, H3-H5) held-out windows are used-holdout: scored before, never tuned on here, reported for comparison. A new held-out sample (Q1-Q5) on holes no earlier window used (18-hole 2, 4, 5, 6 and the north half of 18) is declared and frozen before any round-3 detector runs. Its strata follow the detect census near play (closed 53%, edge 32%, group 10%, isolated 5% of apexes within 90 m of a hole line): two closed squares, an edge, a mixed band and a broadleaf grove. Windows were placed on laser and photo previews only; no detector output was looked at inside them.

declaredBeforeScoring.beatsRoundTwo: the round-3 detector beats round 2 when its F1 on the new evaluation sample (Q1-Q5) is higher than the round-2 detector's, with precision at least 0.9; only then may it be published
declaredBeforeScoring.conifersSubtype: pine/spruce accuracy is the share of evaluation conifers annotated pine or spruce whose published subtype agrees, and the share published (coverage); unannotated conifers are not scored
declaredBeforeScoring.strata: recall by stratum (isolated, group, edge, closed), by type and by height (3-8, 8-15, 15+ m) is reported with the totals
